connector.name: Ui Debugger MCP
connector.registryDescription: Autonomous UI debugging MCP server: an agent drives the browser/desktop, reports bugs + UX issues.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ui-debugger-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the developerz-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
